subject: Insurance
title: Japan: The Most Insured Nation
description: Learn Japan: The Most Insured Nation in one minute.

hook.text: Japan has the highest life insurance ownership rate on Earth. About 90% of households own at least one policy.

buildup.text: After WWII, Japan rebuilt with a savings culture.

twist.text: Japan's aging population now threatens the model. Fewer workers buying policies means less premium income for insurers.

climax.text: Japan shows what happens when an entire culture embraces insurance.

punchline.text: 90% of households insured. Japan built a culture around life insurance.

quiz.question: What percentage of Japanese households own life insurance?
